# WeaveMark

WeaveMark is an experimental Markdown-native specification language for
readable, reusable, and composable prompts. Its hybrid Processor handles
variables, branches, modules, files, contracts, and validation structurally,
while a language model realizes semantic directives such as @refine.

## Start

- Website: https://paulosalem.github.io/weavemark/
- Repository: https://github.com/paulosalem/weavemark
- Tutorial: https://paulosalem.github.io/weavemark/docs/tutorial.html
- Language reference: https://github.com/paulosalem/weavemark/blob/main/docs/usage-reference.md
- Python API: https://paulosalem.github.io/weavemark/docs/python-api.html
- Related work: https://paulosalem.github.io/weavemark/docs/related-work.html

## Offline compiler replays

    pip install weavemark
    weavemark library market-snapshot --replay --verbose --output market-prompt.md
    weavemark library ai-kanban-board --replay

Replay is strict and offline: source, inputs, compiler prompt, schema, imported
modules, tool results, configuration, and recorded call hashes must match.
